content: Ultra-realistic sports broadcast video, cinematic night match atmosphere. A glamorous woman sits in a packed football stadium surrounded by fans in jerseys and scarves. She is mid-drinking the beer cup in her other hand, while a half-eaten French fry on another hand. Suddenly the stadium PA booms her name "[place your name]" — she freezes, eyes wide, everybody looks at her cheering. She carefully sets the beer cup and eats the French fry, wipes her hand with the tissue paper, and throws it. She stands, slides past the row of fans, and walks purposefully down the stadium steps toward the pitch. She steps onto the field — the crowd murmurs with anticipation. The football players on the ground toss the ball towards her. She lines up, takes two measured steps, and sends a powerful, clean kick straight through the goal posts. The stadium erupts. She turns, jogs back toward the broadcast camera with a wide grin, reaches both arms forward, and covers the lens completely with her open palms — the screen goes black. Throughout: broadcast overlay with live score and match timer in top-left corner, sports network watermark top-right, shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the woman, slightly blurred crowd background, natural arena floodlighting, authentic live TV aesthetic.

El estadio estalla. Ella se da la vuelta, trota de regreso hacia la cámara de transmisión con una amplia sonrisa, extiende ambos brazos hacia adelante y cubre completamente el lente con sus palmas abiertas — la pantalla se vuelve negra.
